title: Hard To Control
text: Hard To Control. Not a big fan of this. First issue is the charging. It has a USB plug so it isn't convenient to charge. Second issue is that when you are using it on the handle it is difficult to keep it from bouncing all around. I thought this would work for my oversized, tiled shower, but the scrubbing pad isn't going to last long either.  It might be fine using it handheld, but that kind of defeats the purpose for me.
